title: Prune the Ranges
description: Learn how to run a command over a specific range of lines.

workspace.trimmed.txt:
keep0
DROP0a
DROP0b
keep1
DROP1a
DROP1b
DROP1c
keep2
DROP2a
DROP2b
DROP2c
keep3
DROP3a
DROP3b

objective: The first group's junk pair sits right after the line to keep — remove it with a plain range.
The second group is longer — remove it in one move by ending the range at the next kept line instead of counting it.
The third group — mark where its junk starts, then close the range from there instead of counting again.
The last group runs to the end of the file — remove it in one move by ending the range there instead.
